description: This file defines a React functional component named 'Title' that renders an animated title text, splitting the input string into words and applying spring-based scaling animations to each word based on the current video frame. It utilizes the 'remotion' library for animation timing and configuration.

methods.name: Title
methods.description: React functional component that takes 'titleText' and 'titleColor' as props and renders animated title text with scaling effects.
